history.title: Sprint 3: Collapsible Sub-Sidebar, Inline Titles, Product Hierarchy & Dual-Rail Shell
changes: Collapsible Sub-Sidebar (PIN-007): Implemented smooth 21st.dev inspired sub-sidebar collapse (w-56 to w-0) with rigid inner container preventing text squishing, header PanelLeftClose/Open toggle, keyboard shortcut (⌘\ or [), and localStorage persistence.

Inline Title Editing & Transactional Rollback (PIN-005): Enabled instant double-click title editing directly on product rows with auto-focus, Enter/blur persistence to SQLite via POST /api/products/<sku>/update, emerald visual pulse, and Cmd+Z rollback.

Product Cell Visual Hierarchy (PIN-010): Reorganized table cell into strict 3-tier hierarchy: Line 1 = Editable Title, Line 2 = SKU Mono Badge & Variant Count Accordion Link, Line 3 = 12px Chromatic Color Swatches.
Modal Backdrop Dismiss (PIN-006): Enabled outside-click backdrop dismissal on all modals (New SKU, Casier Hub, Casier Visual Picker, and Version Changelog).

Gateway Pulse Dual-Rail Shell Unification (SHELL-01): Ported permanent 64px Mini-Rail across Stupid Shoot and Stupid Shop with active app indicator pills, eliminating obsolete top headers and unifying suite navigation.
Shoot Studio Robustness: Fixed undefined catalog reference (ReferenceError on ?sku=...) to catalogData and added multi-SKU batch URL query parsing.

history.title: Actionable Atelier Cockpit: 4-Bottleneck Pipeline (Deprecating Passive Macro-KPIs)
changes: Actionable Cockpit: Deprecated legacy passive macro-KPIs in favor of an ultra-dense, 4-bottleneck operational strip (Shoot Studio, Ruptures Imminentes, File Étiquetage QR, Santé Catalogue).
1-Click Interactive Triage: Each cockpit card functions as an instant table filter with visual active states, auto-filter badges with ✕ dismiss, and live count badges.
Vertical Space Reclamation: Reduced top summary bar height by 50% (from ~130px to ~65px), reclaiming significant vertical room for the product inventory table.
Low-Priority Roadmap Registry: Noted thermal print driver edge cases (printer-specific margin calibration) as a low-priority backlog item.

history.title: Sprint 2: Multi-Axes Variations, Chromatic Swatches & 21st.dev Dynamic Bulk Toolbar
changes: Multi-Axes Variations (PIN-004): Integrated multi-dimensional options (Color, Size, Spec/Gauge) with Shopify isomorphism across jewelry, leather accessories, and apparel.
Chromatic Swatches: Rendered calibrated 12px circular color dots under product titles in Table and Grid views with live tooltip stock inspection and 1-click filter/drawer focus.

Dynamic Bulk Floating Toolbar (0xUrvish / 21st.dev): Integrated animated bottom-center pill dock with multi-row selection counter, batch thermal QR printing (50x30 continuous roll), batch casier assignment, and Shoot bridge.
Reversible Batch Deletion (Cmd+Z Transactional Rollback): Backend snapshot architecture enabling safe, instant undo on accidental batch operations.
Drawer Multi-Axes Form: Dynamic field generation reflecting product option configuration with direct SQLite persistence.

history.title: Sprint 1: Offline Autonomy, 8-Pin Resolution, Visual Casier Picker & 540px Modal Drawer
changes: Offline Autonomy: Bundled standalone Tailwind CSS engine in public/vendor/tailwindcss.min.js, eliminating all external CDN dependencies.
Favicon Asset Diet: Compressed 53.3 MB of raw PNGs into optimized Retina 128px assets under 150 KB total, drastically accelerating startup.
Sidebar & Mini-Rail Cleanup (PIN-002, PIN-007, PIN-009): Removed redundant search icon from 64px rail; removed duplicate Shoot Packshot and CSV Export buttons from left menu.

Physical Casier Logistics & Shelf Visual Picker (PIN-005, PIN-006, PIN-008): Created dedicated 'CASIERS & ÉTIQUETTES HUB' sidebar section; engineered 1-click visual Casier Picker popup to assign shelf coordinates without blind typing; linked direct thermal 50x30 QR printing.
Expanded Drawer with Centered Modal Toggle (PIN-003): Widen SKU Inspector drawer from 420px to 540px and introduced [⤢] toggle to switch between Slide-Over Drawer and Centered Modal mode.
Interactive Version Badge & Roadmap Telemetry: Replaced static 'v1.3' text with clickable live version pill opening an in-app Changelog & 5-Sprint Roadmap modal.

history.title: Real Transparent Favicons in Mini-Rail & Sidebar Menu
changes: Replaced sample/emoji placeholders in the 64px mini-rail with official 7 transparent favicons.
Centered ultra-compact feedback pill with comment bubble and live pin counter at the bottom.
Locked Atelier Header A with inline model telemetry.

history.title: Editable Drawer SKU & Minimalist Atelier Header
changes: Enabled direct SKU code modification inside the SKU Inspector Drawer with database cascade & folder migration.
Relocated repository directory path chip directly under the SKU badge in the drawer header with 1-click clipboard copy.
Removed redundant file browser button and manual path input, keeping exclusively the + Ajouter card in the thumbnail filmstrip.

history.title: Multi-Photo Gallery & Horizontal Filmstrip Slider
changes: Added horizontal thumbnail filmstrip slider directly beneath the large hero preview in the SKU Drawer.
Interactive thumbnail selection with electric blue active halo ring and smooth instant image swap.
Ability to set any photo as the primary catalog packshot with one click (★ Définir principale).
Direct [+] Add Photo trigger card at the end of the filmstrip for frictionless upload workflow.
Displayed photo counter badges on both main product table thumbnails and grid view cards.

history.title: Click-to-Type Steppers & Centralized Asset Ingestion
changes: Converted static stock spans into click-to-type number inputs on table rows, grid cards, and variant lists with auto-selection on focus.
Preserved tactile [-] and [+] stepper buttons with zero-latency optimistic updates and background SQLite persistence.
Integrated native Mac file picker ('📁 Parcourir les fichiers (depuis votre Mac)...') in SKU Inspector Drawer.
Engineered automatic asset centralization into data/sample_shops/<brand>/products/<sku>/images/ with auto-mkdir and primary photo linking.
Added explicit canonical repository path indicator in drawer header.

history.title: Interactive Variations Chevron & Streamlined Actions Column
changes: Repositioned variation accordion trigger directly adjacent to product photo thumbnail as a sleek SVG chevron.
Chevron rotates smoothly from right (› closed) to down (⌄ active) upon expansion with tactile feedback.
Removed clunky text button from Actions column, leaving a clean [✏️ Fiche] [🏷️] pair.
Broadened variation scope across all atelier attributes (sizes, finishes, gauges, colors) instead of sizing only.

history.title: Concept C Finalization (Stripe Unified Telemetry Header)
changes: Adopted Concept C as permanent production header based on founder sign-off.
Integrated dynamic telemetry chips into header (Model count, Hub Lille Central, Real-time margin %) with live SQLite synchronization.
Unified action bar: compact clearable search with (⌘K), list/grid toggle, export CSV, and primary + Nouveau SKU button.
Removed dev switcher pill for clean, uncluttered production interface.

history.title: Precision Layout Polish, Table-Fixed Budgeting, Full CRUD, Sonner Toasts & Thermal Print CSS
changes: Layout & Responsiveness: Re-engineered layout with table-fixed geometry, explicit column budget, zero text-wrapping on badges, and fluid viewport behavior across laptop and tablet screens.
Sorting Engine: Clickable column headers (Title, Category, Casier, Stock, Public Price, Atelier Cost) with dynamic ▲/▼ indicators.

Full CRUD & Persistence: Complete product deletion with safety confirmation modal, variant creation/deletion inside drawer, photo binding, and two-way sync between variants.stock and inventory_levels.
CSV Atelier Export: Server-side UTF-8 BOM CSV generator formatted for French spreadsheets and physical stock taking.

Emil Kowalski Tactile Polish: Sonner-style floating toast notifications stack at bottom-right, Web Audio click synthesis, and keyboard shortcuts (⌘K / / for search, N for new SKU, Esc to close, E for CSV export).
Pure Thermal Print CSS: Added @media print rules so printing from the browser isolates strictly the 50x30mm thermal label, hiding all browser chrome and dark sidebars.

history.title: Gateway Pulse Dual-Rail Navigation (Apps Mini-Rail + App Tool Panel)
changes: Implemented authentic 2-tier left navigation matching screenshot: 64px mini-rail with Serious 'S' logo badge, search, and the 6 suite apps icons (with active blue indicator pill), followed by 224px application options panel for Stupid Stock.

Application Menu Panel: App title with v1.2 badge, Kaya Movement active boutique, Core Atelier options (Overview, Low Stock alerts, To shoot, Casier bins) and Tools & Actions (QR labels, Shoot bridge, SQLite audit).
Floating White Canvas: Kept intact with rounded-3xl #FFFFFF on #F8FAFC, 2 hero summary cards, high-density table with alternating hover rows, variant accordion, and slide-over inspector drawer.

history.title: Gateway Pulse Pure Atelier — Single Boutique Focus (Kaya Movement)
changes: Faithful implementation of Design Vault entry-1792936422493 (Gateway Pulse): Asymmetric split with 240px fixed dark sidebar (#0F1117) and floating rounded-3xl white canvas (#FFFFFF) on #F8FAFC background.
Single Boutique Focus: Streamlined exclusively for Kaya Movement Atelier (eliminating multi-brand tabs clutter).
Master Apps Sidebar: Left sidebar houses the 6 suite apps (01. Stock active, 02. Shoot, 03. Shop, 04. Content, 05. Dispatch, 06. Money).
Gateway Pulse Hero Bar: 2 summary metric cards (Total Stock Valuation with electric blue linear progress bar and Atelier Velocity with margin and critical stock alerts).

High-Density Table: Alternating hover rows (hover:bg-slate-50/80), real product photography thumbnails, casier bin coordinates (LIL-A04), inline stock steppers ([-] [+]) with instant SQLite persistence, and pill status badges (ring-1 ring-inset).
Expandable Variants: Real variant accordion (▼ Tailles) displaying size breakdowns.
Slide-over SKU Inspector: Slide-out drawer with direct field editing (title, casier bin, prices, stock) and instant thermal QR label generator (50x30mm).
